verdict.rationale: Forter's Order API supports agentic traffic as a first-class signal: merchants set orderType to AI_AGENT and send transaction-source metadata (e.g. ChatGPT or Gemini), which Forter says improves its risk decisions. The evidence shows only a declared agent order type plus metadata, not verified agent identity. Missing for 10: support for agentic-payment protocols, ingestion or verification of signed agent tokens, delegated spending-scope fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
